seo.title: How It Works: First Call to Sold
seo.description: Four calm steps from your first conversation to sold, with an independent advisor beside you the whole way. See what happens at each stage before you commit to anything.

data.heading: A simple, supported process —
data.lead: Four calm steps, with an advisor walking with you the whole way.

items.title: Tell us about your property
items.body: A short conversation about your home, your timeline and what matters most to you in this move.

items.title: We research suitable agents
items.body: We review recent sales, listing prices and seller reviews to shortlist agents who genuinely fit your suburb.

items.title: You compare your options
items.body: Receive a clear comparison — experience, recent sales, fees and marketing — with notes from your advisor.

items.title: Choose the agent that fits
items.body: Meet your shortlist on your terms, with our advisor present if you’d like. Decide in your own time.

data.heading: Something to hold on to
data.lead: None of this is a sales meeting. Each step leaves you with something written down that you can take away, sleep on, and talk over with your family.

cta.label: See what a comparison looks like

items.title: A read on your own home
items.body: What is selling near you, what buyers in your suburb are looking for, and where your home sits among them.

items.title: The costs, before you commit
items.body: Commission, marketing and the smaller charges that tend to appear later — set out in advance so nothing arrives as a surprise.

items.title: One person who knows your case
items.body: The same advisor from the first call to the signed agreement, so you are never explaining your situation from the beginning again.

data.heading: Ready to find
data.body: Start with a free, no‑pressure conversation. We’ll help you understand your options — and only move forward when it feels right.
